observations: Photo 0: white games console seen from above with the 'XBOX' logo printed on the top; half of the top is a perforated vent grille, no black circular fan vent.
Photo 0: one black Xbox wireless controller lying on the console; part of a box marked 'HDMI' at the right edge.
Photo 1: front of the console shows a slot-loading disc drive and a front button; white casing looks clean.
Photo 2: front corner with the Xbox power button logo; grille and edges show no visible cracks or scratches.
Body shape and grille pattern match the white Xbox One S with disc drive.
No photo of the rear ports, the underside label (storage size, serial), a powered-on screen, or the receipt.
